# `gcp.servicebinding`

ServiceBinding is the resource that defines a Service Directory Service to be used in a BackendService resource.

[networkservices](README.md) · [all services](../README.md)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Service | networkservices |
| Scope | regional |
| Asset type | `networkservices.googleapis.com/ServiceBinding` |
| Hangs off | `projects` |
| Tier | 1 (generic-safe) |
| Mutation timeout | 1200s |
